title: A text table
description:
Write `final class TextTable` with `static String render(List<String[]> rows)`. The first row is the header. Each column is as wide as its longest cell; cells are separated by two spaces; a cell that is a number (it parses as a `double`) is right-aligned, everything else left-aligned; the header is always left-aligned and followed by a line of dashes as wide as the table. Lines end with `\n` and have no trailing spaces.

```
name    qty  price
------------------
tea       3   2.50
coffee   12   6.00
```
hints: Work out every column's width in a first pass, then build the lines with `String.format("%-8s", cell)` for left and `"%8s"` for right alignment (lesson 8.05).
`stripTrailing()` removes the spaces a left-aligned last column leaves at the end of a line.
